title: POWERFUL PRAYER TO CALL UPON GOD IN DAYS OF TROUBLE
text: Somebody here needs to hear what the spirit is saying. The Lord of hosts is rising. The God who answers by fire is in this place. And I feel the weight of glory right now. Something is shifting in the heavenlies. Someone is about to be liberated from a siege that has held them hostage for years. Listen to me. This is not a coincidence that you are here. You came expecting to hear a message. But what God wants to do is to reposition you, to shift you from the place of crying to the place of commanding. Hallelujah. So, we're looking at a title that many people have been thinking about. Powerful prayer to call upon God in days of trouble. And the spirit of God just dropped something in my spirit. He said, tell them that trouble is not your address. It is a season. Do you hear what I'm saying? Trouble is a season, not a settlement. The problem with many believers is that they have become so accustomed to being in trouble that they have forgotten the God who is above trouble. They have forgotten that there is a dimension of faith that transcends circumstance. But listen here, someone here is going to leave this place today and everything is going to be different. I don't know who it is. I don't know what you are facing. But the spirit of God is adamant. He's saying, "I am about to prove myself to you in a way that will reshape your entire understanding of who I am." Let me take us to Psalm 50 14 and 15. Listen to what David says. He says, "Sacrifice, thank offerings to God. Fulfill your vows to the most high and call upon me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you and you shall glorify me." Do you see the sequence here? The God who answers prayer in days of trouble is not a God who is moved by your complaint. He's moved by your thanksgiving. He is moved by your gratitude. He's moved by your vow, by your commitment to honor him even in the darkness. This is what Psalm 50 is showing us. that when you come to God with thanksgiving, when you come with a vow, when you come acknowledging that he's your deliverer, then you position yourself for the manifestation of his power. But there is something deeper that the spirit is steering in me right now. Many of us have been praying wrong prayers. We have been calling upon God with a spirit of desperation, not a spirit of authority. We have been praying like beggars when we should be praying like believers, like sons, like those who know their position. You see, in the days of trouble, you don't call upon God with a broken spirit only. You call upon him with authority. You call upon him knowing that his power is not limited by your circumstance. You call upon him knowing that angels are waiting for the word, that demons are trembling, that sickness cannot stand in the presence of his name. But you must understand this. Trouble itself is trying to silence your prayer. Trouble is trying to convince you that your prayer is too small. Your faith is too weak. Your voice is too insignificant. But I decree and declare that the voice of the believer who stands in the authority of the blood of Jesus Christ is more powerful than the voice of a thousand troubles. One word from your mouth backed by the power of the Almighty can shift kingdoms, can break chains, can open closed doors. In Psalm 27:es 1-4, David says, "The Lord is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?" And then he makes a vow. He says, "One thing I ask of the Lord. This is what I seek. that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple. Do you see what David is doing? He's moving beyond his trouble. He's prophetically declaring his future. He's saying, "I will not camp in this trouble. I will not make a home here. My destiny is in the presence of God." And this is what the spirit wants to unlock in your spirit right now. the ability to rise above your trouble and to prophetically declare your victory. Someone here has been in a dark place. Someone here has been calling and calling and calling and it seems like heaven is silent. You have been praying and the heaven seem to be as brass. But I want to tell you something today that will shift you from despair to dominion. God is not silent. God is preparing. God is orchestrating. God is moving in the unseen realm while you are suffering in the seen realm and the day when you will understand why you went through. This is the day when you will see what God has prepared for you. Listen to me now. In Isaiah 43:es 2 and 3, the Lord says, "When you pass through the waters, I will be with you. And when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned. The flames will not set you ablaze. For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. This is resurrection language. This is the language of a God who walks into the fire with you. Not a God who removes you from the fire, but a God who stands with you in the fire. And that changes everything because now your trial becomes your testimony. Your suffering becomes the stage for his glory. Your pain becomes the platform for his power. I feel the spirit moving right now. There are people in this place who have been trying to pray their way out of something when what God wants to do is to pray you through it. There is a difference. You cannot pray away a season that is meant to mature you. You cannot pray away a process that is meant to position you, but you can pray through it with power. You can pray through it with authority. You can pray through it with the confidence that the God who is with you is bigger than what is against you. Thus said the spirit of the Lord, "Your testimony is not your defeat. Your testimony is the moment when I showed up, the moment when I demonstrated that I am God and there is none like me." Now listen to me because there are dimensions to this that many believers do not understand. When you are in days of trouble, there are principalities and powers that are targeting your prayer. They are trying to silence you. They are trying to convince you that your prayer is ineffective, that God is not listening, that heaven is closed. But I tell you, the enemy is lying. In Ephesians 6 10 through13, Paul writes, "Finally, be strong in the Lord and in his mighty power. Put on the full armor of God so that you can take your stand against the devil's schemes. For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms. Do you understand what Paul is saying? The trouble you are facing in the natural realm is not your real problem. Your real problem is spiritual. The battle is not in the natural. The battle is in the heavenly realms. And the weapon that God has given you to fight this battle is prayer. Not just prayer, powerful prayer, authoritative prayer, prophetic prayer. And that is why we are here. We are here to unlock dimensions of prayer that will shift the spiritual climate around your life. We are here to teach you how to call upon God in such a way that heaven moves, that angels activate, that demons tremble. In Luke 11, Jesus gives us what many call the Lord's prayer. But it is much more than just a model. It is a key. It is a prophecy of how the kingdom operates. It says, "Your kingdom come. Your will be done on earth as it is in heaven." Do you hear that? Your prayer is supposed to bring heaven to earth. Your prayer is supposed to manifest God's reality in your situation. Not to escape your situation, but to transform it. And then Jesus gives us a parable about a man who came to his friend at midnight asking for bread. And though the friend would not give it because of friendship, he would give it because of the man's boldness, because of his persistence, because of his shamelessness. Jesus says in Luke 11:8-10, "I tell you, though he will not get up and give you the bread because he is your friend, yet because of your shameless audacity, he will surely get up and give you all you need." So I say to you, ask and it will be given to you. Seek and you will find. Knock and the door will be open to you. This is the kind of prayer that moves God. Not gentle, timid prayer. Not prayer filled with doubt, but shameless, audacious, persistent prayer. The kind of prayer that will not accept no for an answer. The kind of prayer that keeps knocking until the door opens. Someone in this place has the seed of that kind of prayer in you. But religion has domesticated it. The enemy has convinced you to be proper and respectful when you approach God. But let me tell you something. God is not impressed by your propriety. God is impressed by your persistence. God is moved by your faith. God rises up when he sees that you refuse to accept the enemy's report. I decree and declare right now that every polite prayer that has been robbed of power is being resurrected. I decree that every faithful cry that heaven has been delaying to answer is being activated now by the power of the blood of Jesus. I declare that the ears of the Almighty are now open to hear the prayers that come from this place. In Genesis 32, Jacob wrestled with God and the Bible says in verse 26, "Then the man said, let me go for it is daybreak." But Jacob replied, "I will not let you go unless you bless me." This is the wrestling that God honors. This is the refusal to accept defeat. This is saying I will not move from this place until I receive what God promised me. And what happened? The Bible says that his name was changed. His position was elevated. His destiny was transformed. And that is what God wants to do in your life right now. He wants to wrestle you into your blessing. He wants to pin you down until you refuse to accept the enemy's assignment. He wants to break you so that you will cling to him with a strength that cannot be shaken. Listen here, there are people who come before God in their troubles and they beg, they plead, they cry. But there are others who come before God and they demand their inheritance. And I am not talking about being disrespectful. I am talking about knowing who you are. Knowing that you are a child of the king. Knowing that you have been washed in the blood. Knowing that the same power that raised Jesus from the dead is living in you. In Romans 8:37, Paul says, "No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us. More than conquerors, not barely surviving, not struggling along, but more than conquerors." This is the position you are supposed to operate from when you pray. But listen, I feel something shifting in the spirit. Someone here is breaking. Someone here has been holding on to bitterness against God because he did not answer your prayer the way you wanted him to. You have been serving God. You have been faithful and then when you got to the day of trouble, you called upon him and it seemed like he was distant. It seemed like your prayer bounced off the ceiling. It seemed like heaven was closed. And the spirit is saying, "I hear your complaint. I see your pain. But what you don't understand is that every silence was a season. Every delayed answer was a divine appointment. Every note that you heard was actually God saying, "Not yet, my child. Not yet." There is something I'm preparing you for. And some of you are going to leave here today and you are going to understand that the delay was the blessing. That the heartbreak was the redirection. That the pain was the preparation. Because God is not interested in giving you what you asked for. God is interested in giving you what you need. In 2 Corinthians 12 8 and 9, Paul says, "Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me. But he said to me, my grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." Now, Paul had a thorn, something that was troubling him, something that caused him distress. And he did what many of us do. He asked God to remove it. He prayed the prayer of deliverance. But God said, "No, Paul, I am not going to remove this. I am going to use this. Your turn is going to teach you something about my grace that your breakthrough never could do." And that is what the spirit is speaking to somebody here right now. Your trouble is not meant to destroy you. Your trouble is meant to teach you. Your trouble is meant to position you. Your trouble is the platform for the display of God's power. Now I want to shift something here because we have been building the foundation and now the spirit is ready to move into intercession into warfare prayer. Because you see many believers think that praying in the days of trouble simply means you pray and then you hope. But that is not what the scripture teaches. When you pray in days of trouble, you pray with spiritual authority. You pray with weapons. You pray with power. In Ephesians 6 14-20, Paul talks about the armor of God. He talks about the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, the sword of the spirit. And then he says, "And pray in the spirit on all occasions with all kinds of prayers and petitions. With this in mind, be alert and always keep on praying for all the Lord's people." This is not gentle passive prayer. This is active, militant, aggressive prayer. This is prayer that is dressed for war. Prayer that understands the enemy. Prayer that knows how to bind and how to lose. And that is what I want to do right now. I want to shift into a place where we are going to pray the way the spirit has instructed us, not the way the world has taught us, not the way religion has constrained us, but the way the kingdom operates. So I want to declare something over this place right now. I speak to every demonic power that has been assigned to the lives of the people in this place. Listen to me carefully. Your assignment is cancelled. Your mandate is revoked. Your authority is broken. I decree by the power of the blood of Jesus Christ and by the authority that has been given to me as an apostle of the most high God that every assignment of the enemy against the people in this place is now aborted. Fire, fire, fire. Let the fire of God consume every altar that has been erected against your destiny. Let the consuming fire of the Holy Ghost burn down every structure that the enemy has built in your life. I speak to every witchcraft power, every demonic influence, every principality that has been orchestrating trouble in your life. You are finished. Your time is over. By the blood of Jesus, by the power of his resurrection, by the authority of his name, I decree that the siege is broken. The embgo is lifted. The captivity is ended. You are free. Say it. You are free. Somebody here is going to walk out of this place and the first thing that is going to happen is someone is going to look at you and they are going to say what is different about you and you are going to know that you have been in the presence of the almighty. Now listen to me. I feel the spirit moving in a different direction. Someone here is dealing with a family situation. Someone here has a loved one that is trapped. Someone here is interceding for a son or a daughter or a family member and you have been crying out to God and it seems like nothing is changing. But I want to declare something to you right now. In Matthew 18 18 and 19, Jesus says, "I tell you that whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven and whatever you lose on earth will be loosed in heaven." Again, I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything you ask for, it will be done for you by my father in heaven. Do you understand the power that Jesus is giving you? When you bind something on earth, it is bound in heaven. When you lose something on earth, it is loosed in heaven. This is not prayer. This is authority. This is dominion. And this is what many believers do not understand about calling upon God in days of trouble. You are not supposed to be begging God to do something that he has already given you the authority to do. You are supposed to be operating from a place of dominion. You are supposed to be releasing angels. You are supposed to be commanding demons. You are supposed to be prophetically declaring what you see in the spirit. So right now I want to speak to every family that is in bondage. I want to speak to every household that is under attack. I bind every demonic assignment. I lose the blessing of Abraham. I lose the anointing of David. I lose the favor of Daniel. I lose the wisdom of Solomon. I lose healing. I lose breakthrough. I lose restoration. Somebody here has a child that is lost. Somebody here has a child that has turned away from God. Somebody here has been praying and praying and praying and you have not seen any change. But I want to declare something to you right now. The prayer of a parent for a child is one of the most powerful prayers that can be prayed. It is backed by the covenant of God. It is backed by the promise of God. It is backed by generations of faith. In Isaiah 44:3, the Lord says, "For I will pour water on the thirsty land and streams on the dry ground. I will pour out my spirit on your offspring and my blessing on your descendants. Your children are the heritage of the Lord and the enemy cannot steal what belongs to the Lord. The enemy cannot keep what is covenanted to you. And I decree right now that every child who has been captured by the enemy is being loosed. Every prodigal is coming home. Every wayward heart is being turned. I speak to your sons and your daughters. The love of God is coming after you. The mercy of God is pursuing you and no power in heaven or on earth can stop the father from bringing you home. Someone here right now is dealing with a marriage situation. Someone here has been praying for a breakthrough in their marriage. Someone here is tired of crying alone. Someone here is tired of feeling rejected by the one who was supposed to love you. And the spirit wants me to tell you something. In Ephesians 5, Paul talks about the mystery of marriage. He talks about how marriage is a picture of Christ and the church. And then he says in verse 25, "Husbands, love your wives just as Christ loved the church and gave himself up for her." Marriage is supposed to be a place of sacrifice, a place of dying to self, a place of covenant. But somewhere along the way, it became a place of selfishness, a place of striving, a place of brokenness. And the spirit is saying, I am coming to restore what has been broken. I am coming to heal what has been wounded. I am coming to revive what has been dead. So right now, I declare that every marriage under the sound of my voice that has been targeted by the enemy is being restored. I speak reconciliation. I speak understanding. I speak compassion. I speak love that will not break. I decree that the foundations of your marriage are being rebuilt by the master builder himself and what the enemy meant for evil is being turned to your good. Someone here needs to hear this. Your spouse is going to have a change of heart. This is not the end. This is the beginning. This is not the ending of your story. This is the editing of your story, the rewriting of your story. And when you come through this, your testimony is going to set someone free. I feel fire in my spirit right now. There are financial pressures in this place. There are people who are facing impossible situations. People who have been walking and walking and there is no increase. People who have been believing God and there is no provision. And the enemy is saying God doesn't care about you. God has forgotten you. God doesn't want you to prosper. But listen to what the scripture says in Proverbs 10:22. says the blessing of the Lord brings wealth without painful toil for it. Without painful toil. This means that God's way to prosperity is not stress and strain. It is not huzzle and burnout. It is blessing. It is grace. It is the favor of God. And I'm going to tell you something that will shift your whole thinking. The enemy has convinced many believers that they are not supposed to prosper. that prosperity is cannal, that wealth is worldly, but that is a lie straight from hell. God owns the cattle on a thousand hills. God created wealth. God is the one who gives power to get wealth. In Deuteronomy 8:18, Moses says, "But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth and so confirms his covenant which he swore to your ancestors as it is today." So right now, I decree financial breakthrough. I decree that every gate of provision that has been closed is now open. I decree that every source of income is being multiplied. I decree that the spirit of poverty is broken off your life. I decree that you walk in the abundance of God. I decree that overflow becomes your new normal. Someone here is going to receive a call this week about a job. Someone here is going to have a door open that you thought was permanently sealed. Someone here is going to see an increase that you never expected. And you are going to know that it came from the hand of God. You are going to know that your prayer touched heaven. But listen, there is something else. There is a healing dimension that the spirit is pressing on me right now. Someone here is sick. Someone here is carrying a diagnosis that has been heavy on your heart. Someone here has been praying and praying and the pain has not left. And you are beginning to wonder if God even wants to heal you. But I want to tell you what Jesus says in Mark 11 24. Jesus says, "Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it and it will be yours. Not it will be yours if you deserve it. Not it will be yours if you have enough faith, but it will be yours." This is a decree. This is a promise. This is the word of the savior himself. And there is a spiritual principle here. When you pray for healing, you do not pray expecting to get healed. You pray believing that you are already healed. Because the healing happened at Calvary. Isaiah 53:5 says, "By his wounds we are healed, not we will be healed. We are healed. It is finished. It is complete. It is done." So what are you waiting for? What are you believing for? Your healing is not in the future. Your healing is in the past. Your healing is in the foundation of your faith. And right now I speak to every sickness, every disease, every infirmity. I command you to lose this person. I decree in the name of Jesus that healing power is flowing through your body right now. That every cell is being restored, that every organ is being healed, that every pain is being destroyed. Someone here with arthritis, the inflammation is gone. Someone here with diabetes, your pancreas is being restored. Someone here with cancer. Every malignant cell is being destroyed by the sword of the spirit. I speak wholeness. I speak restoration. I speak the resurrection power of Jesus over your body. And I feel the spirit saying that there is someone here who has been dealing with depression. Someone who has been in darkness. Someone who has been fighting thoughts that are not from God. And the enemy has been telling you that there is no way out. That this is your reality. that you are going to be like this forever. But in John 8:12, Jesus says, "I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life." You do not have to walk in darkness anymore. That darkness that has been covering your mind is being scattered by the light of Jesus. Your thoughts are being taken captive. Your mind is being renewed. Your joy is being restored. The weight that has been on your shoulders is being lifted. And you are going to wake up tomorrow and something is different. Something has shifted. You are going to feel lighter. You are going to feel hope rising in your spirit. Someone here has been suicidal. Someone here has been looking for a way out. And the spirit wants me to tell you that you are not finished. Your story is not over. God has an assignment for you. God has a destiny for you. And the gates of hell itself cannot stop what God has planned for your life. I bind every suicidal thought. I bind every spirit of death. I bind every voice of deception. I lose the spirit of life. I lose the love of God. I lose the hope of resurrection. Your life is valuable. Your life matters and God is not done with you yet. Now listen, I am moving deeper because there is a warfare dimension that we must address. Many believers do not understand the nature of their struggle. They think that their trouble is just circumstance. But the scripture says in Ephesians 6:12, "For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world, and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms. There are powers, there are authorities, there are principalities that are specifically assigned to oppose your destiny. And they are not just generic powers. They are smart. They are organized. They are strategic. And they are targeting you specifically. In Psalm 91 11 and 12, David says, "For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways. They will lift you on their hands so that you will not strike your foot against a stone. But those angels are not going to move until you cry out. Those angels are not going to activate until you release them through prayer. And that is why calling upon God in days of trouble is so important because your cry activates heaven. Your prayer releases angelic armies. Your intercession shifts the spiritual atmosphere. So right now, I want to declare something. I speak to every demonic power that has been assigned to stop you. I speak to every principality that has been working against your purpose. Listen to me. Your time is up. Your assignment is revoked. And I decree by the power that is greater than all powers. By the authority that supersedes all authorities that you are bound, you cannot move. You cannot operate. You cannot manifest. And I release the angelic hosts. I release the armies of heaven. I release the waring angels. I release Michael the archangel to contend with every demon that is opposing you. I release Gabriel to bring news of breakthrough. I release the seraraphim to burn away every altar of the enemy. I release the cereobim to guard the gates of your destiny. By the blood of Jesus, by the power of his name, by the authority of heaven, I declare that the war is over. The victory is won and you are walking into your inheritance. Someone here is receiving a word. Someone here, the spirit is speaking specifically to you. There is a woman here whose name starts with a Ruth or Rachel or Rita or Ruth. The Lord is saying that the reproach is gone. The shame that you have been carrying, the guilt that has been weighing on your spirit, the condemnation that has been following you, it is ended. The Lord is saying, "I have washed you clean. I have declared you righteous. I have made you a new creation and the old things have passed away." Someone here is named Michael. Michael, listen carefully. The Lord is showing me that there is a financial obstruction in your life. There is something that has been blocking your provision. But the spirit says that before the month is over, there is going to be a shift. An unexpected provision is coming. An opportunity that you thought was dead is being revived. And the Lord says, I am about to show you that I am not just a God of the spiritual realm. I am a God who moves in the natural realm. I am a God who opens doors. I am a God who causes provision to flow. There is a sister here and your name has something to do with flowers or something beautiful. Joy, Jasmine. The Lord is showing me that there has been a delay in something that you have been praying for. a blessing that has been delayed. Maybe it is a child, maybe it is a marriage, maybe it is a ministry opportunity. And the Lord wants you to know that the delay was not a denial. The delay was a design. The Lord was preparing something that is bigger than what you asked for. And when it comes, you are going to understand why it took so long. Someone here is dealing with a betrayal. Someone here has been hurt by someone close to you. Someone you trusted has turned against you and the wound is still fresh. But I want to declare something to you. In Genesis 50:20, Joseph says to his brothers who had betrayed him, "You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done, the saving of many lives. Your betrayal is going to become your testimony. Your pain is going to become someone else's deliverance. And the person who hurt you, God is going to deal with them. You do not need to take vengeance. God is the judge. God is the defender. And he's more just than you can ever be. So I speak forgiveness into your spirit. I speak healing into your wounds. And I decree that you are going to rise above this. You are going to be greater than this hurt. And you are going to see the hand of God move in a way that will make your betrayal look small. Now I feel the spirit is calling me into deeper intercession because there are systemic issues here. There are covenants and causes that have been operating for generations. And many people are suffering because of what their ancestors did. Many people are carrying burdens that were not meant to be theirs. In Exodus 20:es 4 and 5, the Lord says, "You shall not make idols for yourselves. For I, the Lord your God, am a jealous God, punishing the children for the sin of the parents, to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me." Now, this does not sound like good news, but there is more. Verse 6 says, "But showing love to a thousand generations of those who love me and keep my commandments." So there are generational blessings and generational causes. And what Jesus did at Calvary was to break every generational cause and to release every generational blessing. And that is what we are doing right now. We are accessing the power of the cross to break what the enemy has built. So I decree that every ancestral cause is broken. Every covenant with darkness is canled. Every agreement with demons is revoked. Every pattern of sickness, poverty, broken marriage, witchcraft, rebellion, every pattern is broken by the blood of Jesus. I speak to the generational anointing. I lose the blessing that God intended for your family. I lose the purpose. I lose the calling. I lose the destiny. What Satan meant to abort, God is resurrecting. What the enemy tried to stop, God is accelerating. and your generation is going to see the manifestation of what God covenanted with your ancestors. Someone here is a carrier of a blessing. Someone here has been chosen to turn the tide for your entire family. Someone here is going to be the generation that breaks the cycle that stands in the gap that says no more. This is where it ends. This is where God's blessing begins. And the enemy has been fighting you ferociously because he knows what you represent. But I speak reinforcement over your life. I speak divine protection. I speak the favor of God. I speak the wisdom of the spirit. I decree that you are going to stand in that gap and you are going to see the redemption of your family. And I feel something shifting. There is a dimension of time restoration that the spirit is emphasizing right now. Many believers do not understand that time is currency in the kingdom. When you waste time, you are wasting destiny. When you delay in your purpose, you are delaying your provision. When you postpone your prayer, you are postponing your breakthrough. In Psalm 31:15, David says, "My times are in your hands." All of your times are in God's hands. That means that God is sovereign over time. God can restore lost time. God can multiply time. God can give you back what the locusts have eaten. In Joel 2 verse 25, the Lord says, "I will repay you for the years. The locusts have eaten the great locust and the young locust. The other locusts and the locust swarm, my great army that I sent among you." Listen to me. The enemy has stolen years from you. The devil has eaten up time through sickness, through bondage, through wrong relationships, through spiritual oppression. But I'm declaring that God is restoring those years. God is giving you back what was stolen and you are going to see in the remaining years more fruit than you saw in all the previous years combined. Someone here has lost time to addiction. Someone here has lost years to a bad relationship. Someone here has wasted seasons to wrong thinking. But I declare that your remaining time is more valuable than all your previous time. I declare that God is compressing blessing into the next season. I declare that you are going to accomplish in two years what should have taken 10. I speak the restoration of virtue. I speak the recovery of strength. I speak the return of youth. I speak divine acceleration. I speak that time is being reordered in your favor. Now there is something that is coming to me about divine preservation. Because as you are moving forward, there are attacks that are going to come. There are enemies that are going to rise up. There are powers that are going to try to stop your momentum. But I want you to know that you are under divine protection. In Proverbs 22:3 says, "The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty." Wisdom is seeing what is coming and positioning yourself accordingly. And that is why we pray. That is why we intercede. That is why we declare the word of the Lord because we are positioning ourselves for the hand of God to protect us. So I declare divine preservation over your life. I declare that the hand of God is upon you. I declare that you are hidden in the secret place of the most high. I declare that the enemy cannot touch you, cannot reach you, cannot harm you. You are sealed. You are protected. You are preserved. Every accident that was supposed to happen is being diverted. Every sickness that was sent to your body is being repelled. Every trap that was set for you is being destroyed. Every ambush is being exposed. And you are walking in safety. You are walking in peace. You are walking in the confidence that God is with you. Someone here has been spared from something. Someone here death was standing at your door and you did not even know it. But God protected you. God preserved you. And the Lord wants you to know that there is still more that he has protected you from. There are attacks that were meant for you that never reached you because of the blood of Jesus. Rejoice. Rejoice. Your life is preserved by the grace of God. I feel fire rising in my spirit again. Because we are not just dealing with natural enemies. We are dealing with spiritual enemies. We're dealing with witchcraft. We're dealing with demonic powers. We are dealing with sorcery and enchantments and spells that have been released against the people of God.
